verses.raw: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allāh, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."
verses.text: And We had certainly given to David and Solomon knowledge, and they said, "Praise [is due] to Allāh, who has favored us over many of His believing servants."

verses.raw: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."
verses.text: And Solomon inherited David. He said, "O people, we have been taught the language of birds, and we have been given from all things. Indeed, this is evident bounty."

verses.raw: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows
verses.text: And gathered for Solomon were his soldiers of the jinn and men and birds, and they were [marching] in rows

verses.raw: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."
verses.text: Until, when they came upon the valley of the ants, an ant said, "O ants, enter your dwellings that you not be crushed by Solomon and his soldiers while they perceive not."

verses.raw: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me<sup foot_note=255688>1</sup> to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."<sup foot_note=255689>2</sup>
verses.text: So [Solomon] smiled, amused at her speech, and said, "My Lord, enable me to be grateful for Your favor which You have bestowed upon me and upon my parents and to do righteousness of which You approve. And admit me by Your mercy into [the ranks of] Your righteous servants."

verses.raw: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?
verses.text: And he took attendance of the birds and said, "Why do I not see the hoopoe - or is he among the absent?

verses.raw: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."<sup foot_note=255690>1</sup>
verses.text: I will surely punish him with a severe punishment or slaughter him unless he brings me clear authorization."

verses.raw: But he [i.e., the hoopoe] stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.
verses.text: But he [i.e., the hoopoe] stayed not long and said, "I have encompassed [in knowledge] that which you have not encompassed, and I have come to you from Sheba with certain news.

verses.raw: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.
verses.text: Indeed, I found [there] a woman ruling them, and she has been given of all things, and she has a great throne.

verses.raw: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allāh, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided,
verses.text: I found her and her people prostrating to the sun instead of Allāh, and Satan has made their deeds pleasing to them and averted them from [His] way, so they are not guided,

verses.raw: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allāh, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -
verses.text: [And] so they do not prostrate to Allāh, who brings forth what is hidden within the heavens and the earth and knows what you conceal and what you declare -

verses.raw: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."
verses.text: Allāh - there is no deity except Him, Lord of the Great Throne."

verses.raw: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.
verses.text: [Solomon] said, "We will see whether you were truthful or were of the liars.

verses.raw: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."
verses.text: Take this letter of mine and deliver it to them. Then leave them and see what [answer] they will return."

verses.raw: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.
verses.text: She said, "O eminent ones, indeed, to me has been delivered a noble letter.

verses.raw: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it is [i.e., reads]: 'In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,
verses.text: Indeed, it is from Solomon, and indeed, it is [i.e., reads]: 'In the name of Allāh, the Entirely Merciful, the Especially Merciful,

verses.raw: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].'"
verses.text: Be not haughty with me but come to me in submission [as Muslims].'"

verses.raw: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."<sup foot_note=255694>1</sup>
verses.text: She said, "O eminent ones, advise me in my affair. I would not decide a matter until you witness [for] me."

verses.raw: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."
verses.text: They said, "We are men of strength and of great military might, but the command is yours, so see what you will command."

verses.raw: She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do.
verses.text: She said, "Indeed kings - when they enter a city, they ruin it and render the honored of its people humbled. And thus do they do.

verses.raw: But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."
verses.text: But indeed, I will send to them a gift and see with what [reply] the messengers will return."

verses.raw: So when they came to Solomon, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allāh has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.
verses.text: So when they came to Solomon, he said, "Do you provide me with wealth? But what Allāh has given me is better than what He has given you. Rather, it is you who rejoice in your gift.

verses.raw: Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."
verses.text: Return to them, for we will surely come to them with soldiers that they will be powerless to encounter, and we will surely expel them therefrom in humiliation, and they will be debased."

verses.raw: [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"
verses.text: [Solomon] said, "O assembly [of jinn], which of you will bring me her throne before they come to me in submission?"

verses.raw: A powerful one from among the jinn said, "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this [task] strong and trustworthy."
verses.text: A powerful one from among the jinn said, "I will bring it to you before you rise from your place, and indeed, I am for this [task] strong and trustworthy."

verses.raw: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."
verses.text: Said one who had knowledge from the Scripture, "I will bring it to you before your glance returns to you." And when [Solomon] saw it placed before him, he said, "This is from the favor of my Lord to test me whether I will be grateful or ungrateful. And whoever is grateful - his gratitude is only for [the benefit of] himself. And whoever is ungrateful - then indeed, my Lord is Free of need and Generous."

verses.raw: He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."
verses.text: He said, "Disguise for her her throne; we will see whether she will be guided [to truth] or will be of those who is not guided."

verses.raw: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh].
verses.text: So when she arrived, it was said [to her], "Is your throne like this?" She said, "[It is] as though it was it." [Solomon said], "And we were given knowledge before her, and we have been Muslims [in submission to Allāh].

verses.raw: And that which she was worshipping other than Allāh had averted her [from submission to Him]. Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people."
verses.text: And that which she was worshipping other than Allāh had averted her [from submission to Him]. Indeed, she was from a disbelieving people."

verses.raw: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water<sup foot_note=255703>1</sup> and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."
verses.text: She was told, "Enter the palace." But when she saw it, she thought it was a body of water and uncovered her shins [to wade through]. He said, "Indeed, it is a palace [whose floor is] made smooth with glass." She said, "My Lord, indeed I have wronged myself, and I submit with Solomon to Allāh, Lord of the worlds."
